{'text': '《時代》雜誌剛剛公布咗2026年最佳發明嘅榜單，iPhone Duo成功上榜，John Ternus亦登上雜誌封面。以下係Ternus接受《時代》雜誌訪問時嘅分享。', 'paragraph_context': "TIME has just published its list of the best inventions of 2026, and iPhone Duo made the list with John Ternus featured on the magazine cover. Here's what Ternus said in his interview with TIME."}

{'text': 'John Ternus談iPhone Duo嘅由來、延遲上市等話題', 'paragraph_context': 'John Ternus on iPhone Duo origins, delay to market, more'}

{'text': 'John Ternus坐低接受《時代》雜誌嘅專訪，主要圍繞iPhone Duo，但同時亦討論咗唔同嘅其他話題，包括AI。', 'paragraph_context': 'John Ternus sat down with TIME for a wide-ranging interview centered on iPhone Duo, but also covering a variety of other topics, including AI.'}

{'text': '講到iPhone Duo嘅時候，呢部機比其他摺疊屏幕手機遲咗接近十年先至上市，而Ternus早喺2011年已經喺Apple參與早期嘅摺疊屏幕研發工作。', 'paragraph_context': 'Regarding the iPhone Duo, which is hitting the market nearly a decade after other foldables, Ternus was involved in early foldable work at Apple all the way back in 2011.'}

{'text': '2011年，當時好多人都仲用緊揭蓋式手機，Ternus同另外五名工程師就申請咗一項關於可摺疊電子裝置嘅專利，探討呢種構思需要咩類型嘅電池同電路板。Ternus話：「好清楚嘅係，我哋遲早會到一個地步，OLED顯示屏變得可以屈曲。」', 'paragraph_context': 'In 2011, when many people still carried around flip phones, Ternus and five other engineers filed a patent application for foldable electronic devices, exploring what kind of batteries and circuit boards might be needed for such an idea. "It felt clear that we were going to eventually get to a place where OLED displays were going to be flexible," Ternus says.'}

{'text': 'Ternus對2010年代其他公司嘅早期摺疊屏幕嘗試都唔係幾睇好。佢話：「世界上其他嘅例子都畀人一種廉價同差劣嘅感覺。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Ternus wasn\'t a fan of early attempts at foldables from other companies in the 2010s. He says, "The other examples in the world felt kind of cheap and crappy."'}

{'text': 'Apple產品設計副總裁Richard Dinh分享咗一個故事，可以見到佢哋好想造出一部同競爭對手唔同嘅摺疊手機。', 'paragraph_context': "The drive to achieve a foldable unlike its competitors is evidenced by a story from Richard Dinh, Apple's VP of Product Design."}

{'text': '喺過程中，Ternus鼓勵團隊喺呢個項目上投放更多時間同精力，即使其他摺疊屏幕手機已經搶先上市。Dinh話，曾經有一段時間，佢問Ternus佢哋嘅團隊應唔應該採用一種同競爭對手相似嘅表面材料，Dinh認為雖然有瑕疵，但可能已經夠用。', 'paragraph_context': 'Along the way, Ternus encouraged the team to invest more time and effort in the project, even as other foldables beat them to market. Dinh says that at one point, he asked Ternus whether his team should proceed with a top surface material similar to those of its competitors, which Dinh felt had flaws but was potentially good enough.'}

{'text': '「佢就好似話：『睇住啦，Rich，你會知道幾時係啱嘅時機。』呢番說話畀咗我哋信心去真正突破創新同製造嘅界限，仲周圍飛去聯繫大家嘅供應商，一齊研發出呢種納米紋理（一種表面技術）。」Dinh話。最終嘅成品——用特製聚合物製成嘅表面，建基於一個內部有超過100個精密細小組件嘅鉸鏈——令首批用家讚嘆不已，話佢哋幾乎完全偵測唔到摺痕。', 'paragraph_context': '"And he was like, \'Look, Rich, you\'ll know when it\'s the right thing.\' And that gave us the confidence to really push the boundaries on innovation and manufacturing, and fly worldwide to connect our suppliers together and come up with the nanotexture [a surface technology]," Dinh says. The result—a surface made from a custom polymer and built atop a hinge with more than 100 tiny interior precision components—has impressed its first users, who have said they can barely detect a crease at all.'}

{'text': '最高讚好留言由Fats', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by Fats'}

{'text': '對設計嘅執著——正正係Apple保持領先所需要嘅嘢。', 'paragraph_context': 'Obsessing over design - this is what Apple needs to stay on top.'}

{'text': '好開心見到係一位產品工程師掌舵。', 'paragraph_context': 'Glad a product engineer is at the helm.'}

{'text': '篇報導仲提到Ternus「喺佢擔任CEO嘅初期，大部分都係專注喺設計上，每週花多日時間喺工作室同工業設計及人機介面團隊一齊」。呢點同《彭博》之前有關Ternus早期工作重點嘅報導不謀而合。', 'paragraph_context': 'The story also mentions that Ternus "has devoted much of his early tenure as CEO to obsessing over design, spending multiple days a week in the studio with the industrial-design and human-interface teams." This echoes previous Bloomberg reporting around Ternus\'s early priorities.'}

{'text': 'Ternus喺訪問中亦提到嘅其他話題包括：', 'paragraph_context': 'Other topics Ternus addresses in the interview include:'}

  • {'text': 'Apple Intelligence對Gemini技術嘅依賴：「我哋嘅目標唔係要將每一樣嘢都自己造。我哋只造嗰啲我哋真係能夠帶來差異化嘅嘢。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple Intelligence\'s reliance on Gemini technology: "There\'s not really a goal that we have to make every single thing in a product. We make the things where we can really bring differentiation."'}
  • {'text': 'Siri AI嘅獨特優勢：「你生活上嘅所有嘢都喺你部電話入面。有了Siri AI，你可以利用所有呢啲資訊去做嘢、學嘢、解難，呢種能力係其他人都做唔到嘅。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Siri AI\'s unique advantages: "Everything in your life is on your phone. With Siri AI, you can leverage all that information to do things, learn things, and figure out things in a way that nobody else can do."'}
  • {'text': '九月活動前瞓得少：「嗰日我完全係靠腎上腺素、咖啡因同興奮感支撐住。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Not sleeping much before September event: "I was on such a moment of adrenaline and caffeine and excitement for the day."'}

{'text': '《時代》雜誌嘅全文非常值得一睇，可以喺呢度睇到。', 'paragraph_context': 'The full TIME article is well worth a read, available here.'}
